Name: Smartphone
Author: HaPyke
Description:
[center][font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=6][color=#FF0000]S[/color][color=#FF9900]m[/color][color=#CBFF00]a[/color][color=#32FF00]r[/color][color=#00FF66]t[/color][color=#00FEFF]p[/color][color=#0065FF]h[/color][color=#3200FF]o[/color][color=#CC00FF]n[/color][color=#FF0098]e[/color][/size]

[size=4]A smartphone that allows you to text with NPCs, take photos to share with them, or scroll through StardewSocial—a social media platform where both you and the NPCs can share your thoughts.[/size][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][youtube]9dBTL2LSdik[/youtube][/font]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[left]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Introduction and build-in apps:[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Open your phone with key [b]H[/b] [i](you can change it with GMCM), [/i]and use the magical Esc to close.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Notification: An app that shows all of your notifications.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Messages: Here you can chat with your friends. The first message of the day will be the vanilla dialogue. When you continue the conversation, AI will roleplay as the NPC and respond to you. You can even send photos to them—how cool is that?[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Camera: Functionally similar to taking a screenshot of your game, but you can use these photos to share with others or post them on StardewSocial.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Photo: A gallery where you can view all the photos you have taken. You also have the ability to set them as your phone background or player avatar (square images only).[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]StardewSocial: Where the fun happens! Every once in a while, NPCs will write posts here, and they will also like and comment on other posts, including yours. Similarly, you can write your own posts—and don't forget to attach the photos you just snapped.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Setting: Customize your phone by changing the theme, sounds, text colors, and more...[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Calendar: Well, it speaks for itself. [/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]UnlimitedEventExpansion [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46249]>>> here[/url][/size][/color][/font][/left]
[left][list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]UnlimitedEventExpansion is a companion mod to Smartphone that adds repeatable events for every single NPC (for example: picnics, dining out, birthday parties, etc.).[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Note: Some functions of Smartphone will hook into UEE, but UEE is not required to use the base Smartphone mod.[/font][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][url=https://ibb.co/hRBWRLSt]
[/url][/size][/font][/color]
[center][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][url=https://ibb.co/cKxLKjhz][img]https://i.ibb.co/GfFTfqQg/1-Copy.jpg[/img][/url][/size][/font][/color][/center]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Usage limit and more:[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][size=2][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]This mod costs me [b][i][u]REAL MONEY[/u][/i][/b] for every message you send. For me and other fellow players, please use it responsibly.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]To help balance the costs, you are limited to a certain number of uses per in-game day. To bypass this limitation, you can get and use your own OpenAI API key, which means you will be paying for your own usage.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=2][b][i][u]HIGHLY RECOMMENED:[/u][/i][/b] It is very easy and cheap ([b]and even free[/b]) to use your own key. You will no longer face daily limits and will have a much better overall experience. See the instructions under [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4386]IMPROTANT: GET YOUR OWN KEY[/url][/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Compatablility:[/size][/color][/font][/left]
[left][list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Other language: Change AI language in Config -> Language[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Multiplayer: Fully supported. Players can text each other, view, comment, and create posts. [/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Custom NPCs: Fully supported for SVE and RSV. Partially supported for VMV, SBV, Zuzu, and Luna - Astray. Other custom NPCs are functional but require manual customization for the best quality (see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4384]instruction[/url]).[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Mobile: Fully supported[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Split-screen: Not tested. Likely not work.[/font][/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#00ff00][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]Customization:[/size][/font][/color][/left]
[left][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]FOR USERS: You can tailor the experience to your liking, including the phone's theme and NPC characteristics (how they will respond to you), and more. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=articles]USER GUIDE[/url][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]FOR ADVANCE USERS: You can provide custom API to call to any provider/local LLM. See [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4405]ADVANCE[/url][/font][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]FOR MODDERS: Smartphone provides APIs to register custom apps, send notifications, and more. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=articles]MODDER GUIDE[/url][/font][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][/left]
[center]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=6][color=#FF4747]S[/color][color=#FF7747]u[/color][color=#FFA747]p[/color][color=#FFD747]p[/color][color=#F7FF47]o[/color][color=#C7FF47]r[/color][color=#97FF47]t[/color] [color=#67FF47]m[/color][color=#47FF57]e[/color] [color=#47FF87]k[/color][color=#47FFB7]e[/color][color=#47FFE7]e[/color][color=#47E7FF]p[/color] [color=#47B7FF]t[/color][color=#4787FF]h[/color][color=#4757FF]e[/color] [color=#6747FF]l[/color][color=#9747FF]i[/color][color=#C747FF]g[/color][color=#F747FF]h[/color][color=#FF47D7]t[/color] [color=#FF47A7]o[/color][color=#FF4777]n[/color][/size][/font]
[/center]
[center][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]I want to keep this mod free and available for everyone. However, the day may come when I can no longer financially support thousands of users, and I understand that not everyone can afford to use their own key.[/font][/color][/center]
[center][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Your support here will help keep that day far away—or ensure it never comes at all!

[size=4][i]~ [url=https://ko-fi.com/hapyke]Ko-fi[/url] ~[/i][/size][/font][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][i][url=https://ibb.co/P7xh62n][img]https://i.ibb.co/Q29NKWR/2.jpg[/img][/url][/i][/size][/font][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][i]
[color=#00ff00]Disclaimer:[/color][/i][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][i]This mod revolves around the use of AI. Please do not come here just to point out that it uses AI—that's the whole point![/i][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Your messages are sent to ChatGPT to generate responses, similar to how you use it everyday. Because of this, it is a good practice to [u]not[/u] include sensitive information in your messages - for example your credit card numbers.[/i][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][i]The mod generate a summary of your conversation with the NPC and save it in the mod folder. That mean the more you talk with the NPC, the smarter the response you have.[/i][/font][/color][/*]
[/list]
